statement: Every message text is invented for this corpus. No stored conversation, real user text, real name, phone number, e-mail or street address was used. The expected values are contract expectations read from source, NOT observed behaviour of any provider or of the database matcher, and carry no pass rate.
language: sr-Latn; Cyrillic only where a case marks script CYRILLIC

consumerClassLegend.HARD: blocks manual application as well as automatic dispatch (match_detail hardBlockers)
consumerClassLegend.SCORE: contributes to the explainable ranking score (capability 30, schedule 25, distance 15, resources 15, reliability 10, fairness 5)
consumerClassLegend.APPLICATION_TIME: enforced when applying or selecting (TEAM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED), not at dispatch
consumerClassLegend.NONE: the matcher is never reached: the task is blocked or sent to policy review before publication

availabilityShapes.AVAILABLE_NOW_AND_SCHEDULED: availableNow true and a weekly rule covers the task time
availabilityShapes.SCHEDULED_ONLY: availableNow false, a weekly rule covers the task time
availabilityShapes.AVAILABLE_NOW_ONLY: availableNow true, no rule covers the task time
availabilityShapes.NONE_DECLARED: availableNow false and nothing covers the task time

openAssumptions: A1: need.task_country_code is expected to be RS whenever the person names a Serbian locality or a remote task in the Serbian market. The interview can also ask for the country (questionKey need.task_country_code); if the product decides it must always ask, every case that sets RS flips.
A2: a neighbourhood name is always accompanied by the city in the message text (for example Liman in Novi Sad), so the expected geography point carries label plus city and never invents a city.

A3: reference worker expectations (eligibility, hardBlockers, dispatchBlockers, applicationTimeBlockers) are a SOURCE reading of the matcher baseline plus the W02 persistent-availability patch and the PKG-031b kinds. Later packages (pkg015b, pkg027a, pkg029a, pkg033a, B24) were not re-read for scheduling; radius is predicted by city-name equality although the live gate uses a geodesic distance when both positions exist. Slice S03 diffs these against the real bodies.
A4: availability rule startsOn is the server local date of the turn in this corpus (2026-10-05).
A5: READY_FOR_REVIEW means the facts the AI can propose are complete; the person still confirms the map point(s), opens the explicit review and chooses to publish. The AI is never the confirmation.

A6: publication outcomes quote the owner-locked MINIMUM policy (NOT production activated) and, for regulated areas, the LEG-05 draft that is not legally reviewed. They are expectations for a policy gate that does not yet run in production.

A7: the hidden kind is read by the matcher from need.category plus need.required_skills (tasks) and from skills (workers) with the PKG-031b stems; currentStemsYield is a JavaScript port of those stems evaluated on the canonical wording the corpus expects the AI to write.
